title: Hezekiah Wardwell Fellowship
summary: Fellowships for young Spanish musicians and musicologists to pursue further training or advanced studies at a German music academy or conservatory.

degree_levels.notes: Bachelor's or comparable academic degree completed no longer than 3 years prior to the start of the fellowship

institutions.notes: An academy of music or a conservatory in Germany, or higher education institutions.

residence.notes: Applicants should live in Spain or have completed their education in Spain.

mandatory.text: Bachelor's or comparable academic degree completed no longer than 3 years prior to the start of the fellowship
Binding agreement for academic supervision or acceptance prior to application
Spanish citizenship, live in Spain or have completed education in Spain

preferences.text: Preference will be given to candidates who have not yet had the opportunity to study in Germany.

funding.description: Monthly sponsorship sum of 1,000 EUR. Single standard starting allowance of 250 EUR and a single standard travel expense allowance for fellowship holders travelling from Spain.
funding.duration: 1 or 2 academic semesters (grant period: October to February or July of the following year)

application_rounds.notes: Application deadline is 10 January of each year. Extracted deadline was '01-10'; year not confirmed.

recurring_deadline_notes: Application deadline is 10 January of each year.

sources.title: Alexander von Humboldt Foundation: Hezekiah Wardwell Fellowship - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Supports international students from Spain for physical study at a music academy or conservatory in Germany.
